Ruling: representation; f8863 p. 1, line 15: "Subtract line 14 from line 13. If zero or less, skip lines 16 and 17, enter -0- on line 18, and go to line 19". The English floors line 15 at zero; the skip is carried by shown_when. Lines 13 to 16 are shown only on f8863.show_llc, which requires f8863.show_after4 (line 4 above zero) and line 10 above zero. Line 13 is line 2 and line 14 is line 3 (both Form 1040 line 11b, both refused with excluded income), so line 15 equals line 4 and is above zero wherever lines 15 and 16 are shown; where line 15 would be zero, line 4 has stopped the form and lines 15 to 19 are hidden. Line 18 is line 12 times line 15 / line 16, so a zero line 15 would give -0- as printed. Same point as the earlier rounds, re-checked on the current f8863.yaml (BUG-0392 changed only the dependent bar of f8863.eligible). Project stands on the English.
